# AZAFCO International - Fresh Fish Export (Egypt)

> Egyptian B2B company, founded in 2008. We farm and source fresh fish in Egypt, then inspect, grade, pack and export it to importers, wholesalers and distributors in 7+ markets across the Middle East and beyond.

## Company information
- Name: AZAFCO International (ازافكو العالمية)
- Legal name: AZAFCO International for Investment and Development S.A.E.
- Arabic legal name: ازافكو العالمية للاستثمار والتنمية (ش.م.م)
- Legal form: Egyptian joint-stock company (S.A.E., شركة مساهمة مصرية) under Law 159/1981
- Commercial Register: No. 100776
- Industry: Fresh fish farming, sourcing, packing and export (B2B)
- Founded: 2008
- Packing capacity: up to 2,500 t/month
- Location: Industrial Zone, Motobas, Kafr El Sheikh, Egypt
- Website: https://azafco.com.eg (Arabic: /ar, English: /en; also /es, /ru, /de, /fr)

## What we do
We farm and source fish, then inspect, wash, ice, grade, pack and export it fresh. Every stage is handled by AZAFCO, from the pond to the pallet, with our own refrigerated trucks, logistics and cold stores. B2B only (no retail). Specifications, packing, volumes, prices and shipping terms are confirmed per order.

## Products (12 main species)
All species: https://azafco.com.eg/en/products
1. Tilapia (بلطي) - Oreochromis niloticus - https://azafco.com.eg/en/products/tilapia
2. Sea bass (قاروص) - Dicentrarchus labrax - https://azafco.com.eg/en/products/sea-bass
3. Grey mullet (بوري) - Mugil cephalus - https://azafco.com.eg/en/products/mullet
4. Grass carp (حشايش) - Ctenopharyngodon idella - https://azafco.com.eg/en/products/grass-carp
5. Common carp (قشرة) - Cyprinus carpio - https://azafco.com.eg/en/products/common-carp
6. Catfish (قراميط) - Clarias gariepinus - https://azafco.com.eg/en/products/catfish
7. Meagre (لوت) - Argyrosomus regius - https://azafco.com.eg/en/products/meagre
8. Thinlip mullet (طوبار) - Chelon ramada - https://azafco.com.eg/en/products/thinlip-mullet
9. Bayad catfish (بياض) - Bagrus bajad - https://azafco.com.eg/en/products/bayad-catfish
10. Silver carp (سلفر) - Hypophthalmichthys molitrix - https://azafco.com.eg/en/products/silver-carp
11. Mirror carp (مبروكة) - Cyprinus carpio (mirror variety) - https://azafco.com.eg/en/products/mirror-carp
12. Sea bream (دنيس) - Sparus aurata - https://azafco.com.eg/en/products/sea-bream
These are our main, most-requested species; we supply other species on request. Weight grades and availability are confirmed per order with the export team.

## Export markets (7+)
Markets overview: https://azafco.com.eg/en/markets
- Active, with the year we started: United Arab Emirates (2008), Kuwait (2009), Bahrain (2012), Lebanon (2015), Qatar (2024), Iraq (2025), Syria (2026)
- Paused: Spain
- Planned: Europe, Russia, United States
We ship by air and road. Enquiries from other destinations are reviewed case by case.

## Quality
We hold three ISO certificates, certified by TÜV AUSTRIA: ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018. Details: https://azafco.com.eg/en/quality
